Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. The U-19 World Cup action to continue on 1st February with the first semi-final coming your way. In this game, Afghanistan Under-19 will take on England Under-19. Which will be the first team to step into the finals? To find out join us at 1830 IST (1300 GMT). But as you all know our build-up begins a little early. Till then take care and goodbye!
Dhruv Parashar wins the Man of the Match award.

Earlier in the innings, after electing to bat first, Ireland batters could not justify their skipper's decision and were bundled out for 122 runs. Later, United Arab Emirates Under-19 chased the target down convincingly to win the game by 8 wickets.

Ireland U-19 were behind in the chase from the first ball itself. They picked up the first wicket on 41 runs but since then they erred their lines and lengths and UAE batters were on their toes to pounce on it. But to be honest, the Irish bowlers had nothing to fight for.

A top-class performance by UAE. They walk out of the campaign with their head held high. UAE win their first silverware in an ICC event. This is a huge achievement for UAE cricket. UAE were off to a flying start, thanks to their opening pair. Even though Dhruv Parashar slipped out early, Kai Smith grew into his innings and a flourished stand with Punya Mehra helped them to get closer to the finish line. In the end, Mehra and Keswani applied the finishing touches to become the plate champions.

All the United Arab Emirates Under-19 players sprint out onto the pitch. Delight in the UAE camp. This chase was a one-way traffic, to be honest. UAE never gave a sniff to Ireland and in the end, have come out on top quite convincingly. All the United Arab Emirates Under-19 players line-up and celebrate by doing push-ups first, followed by some victory dance.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Heartbreak for Kai Smith, he holes out on 49. But all-in-all a great knock by the young lad. He made sure to build a solid platform for his side. A short ball, outside off. Smith goes back and looks to cut it away. He only manages to feather it to the keeper. Joshua Cox makes no mistakes behind the stumps.
